# Domain Arithmetic: One-Shot VLA Adaptation under Environmental Shifts (ECCV 2026) Official implementation of **"Domain Arithmetic: One-Shot VLA Adaptation under Environmental Shifts"** (ECCV 2026). [`Taewook Kang`](https://twkang43.github.io)\* | [`Taeheon Kim`](https://ta3h30nk1m.github.io/)\* | [`Donghyun Shin`](https://github.com/Donghyun1228) | [`Jonghyun Choi`](https://ppolon.github.io/)† \* Equal contribution    † Corresponding author [[Paper]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00666) [[Project Page]](https://twkang43.github.io/projects/dart/) ## 🧭 Overview > **TL;DR.** **Domain ARiThmetic (DART)** adapts multi-task vision-language-action (VLA) models to environmental shifts using only **one demonstration of one task** through subspace-aligned weight arithmetic. This repository provides: - one-shot fine-tuning scripts for `π₀.₅` on LIBERO visual-shift data, - the DART implementation in [`domain_arithmetic/`](domain_arithmetic/), - `LIBERO-view` evaluation scripts. ## 📢 Updates - [x] Release the paper on [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00666). - [x] Launch the [project page](https://twkang43.github.io/projects/dart/). - [x] Release code. - [ ] Upload one-shot fine-tuning datasets and checkpoints. ## 📦 Installation Clone the repository with submodules: If you already cloned the repository, initialize the submodules manually: We use [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) to manage Python dependencies. After installing `uv`, set up the environment with: `GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1` is required because LeRobot is pulled as a dependency. ## 💾 Fine-tune VLA Models with One-Shot Data ### Base VLA Model We use the `pi05_libero` checkpoint from [openpi](https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi) as the source-trained multi-task VLA model. The checkpoint is trained on the [LIBERO](https://github.com/Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO) benchmark: By default, OpenPI downloads this checkpoint from `gs://openpi-assets` and caches it under `~/.cache/openpi`. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出Domain Arithmetic (DART)，通过子空间对齐的权重算术（subspace-aligned weight arithmetic），仅使用一个任务的单次示范（one-shot demonstration）即可快速适应多任务VLA模型到新的环境变化。


# 一、动机

> 现有的多任务视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在环境变化（如光照、背景、视角）下性能严重下降，需要大量新领域数据才能重新适应，缺乏高效适应能力。


# 二、方法

> 提出Domain Arithmetic (DART)，通过子空间对齐的权重算术（subspace-aligned weight arithmetic），仅使用一个任务的单次示范（one-shot demonstration）即可快速适应多任务VLA模型到新的环境变化。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在LIBERO视觉偏移数据集上，DART仅用一次示范即可显著提升模型在新环境下的任务成功率；例如，在多个环境变化场景下，平均成功率相比微调提升超过20%（具体数值请参考论文）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 方法依赖VLA模型的结构（如扩散策略）和任务间的共享表示，可能不适用于完全异质的模型；但权重算术的思想简单且高效，可推广到其他机器人适应场景。
